title: Things Nobody Tells You on Day One

pre.en: What does Mia write in the last line of the guide?
pre.zh: Mia 在指南最后一行写了什么？
options: Advice about the man in the old photo

intro: 这是第 4 单元的融汇课：小陈和 Mia 一起给新来的开发 Ollie 写入职指南，一边斗嘴一边写。这一周学过的「动词后面接什么」都在这儿：remember to do、avoid doing、expect sb to do、let sb do、get it working、spend time doing。最后一行，Mia 又回到了第 32 课的那张照片。

sentences.en: Rachel asked us to write a one-page guide to help Ollie settle in.
sentences.zh: Rachel 让我们写一页纸的指南，帮 Ollie 尽快适应。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: I've already got twelve pages.
sentences.zh: 我已经写了十二页了。

sentences.en: Twelve?
sentences.zh: 十二页？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: We could just write one line: "Ask Mia."
sentences.zh: 干脆就写一行：「问 Mia。」

sentences.en: Very funny.
sentences.zh: 真好笑。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Let's go through my list, then.
sentences.zh: 那我们把我的清单过一遍吧。

sentences.en: Number one: remember to renew the certificates.
sentences.zh: 第一条：记得给证书续期。

sentences.en: Keep in mind that Ollie's a developer, not a tester.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，Ollie 是开发，不是测试。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: He won't be in charge of certificates.
sentences.zh: 证书不归他管。

sentences.en: Nobody was, last time!
sentences.zh: 上次也没人管啊！
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Number two: avoid booking meetings on Wednesdays.
sentences.zh: 第二条：星期三别约会议。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 有道理。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: And don't expect Arjun to reply after six, his time.
sentences.zh: 还有，按 Arjun 那边的时间，六点以后别指望他回消息。

sentences.en: He always follows up first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他总是第二天一早再跟进。

sentences.en: Ollie will get used to waiting.
sentences.zh: Ollie 慢慢就习惯等了。

sentences.en: Number three: let testers break things.
sentences.zh: 第三条：让测试放手去搞破坏。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: It's our job.
sentences.zh: 那是我们的工作。

sentences.en: Number four: nobody can get you up to speed in a week.
sentences.zh: 第四条：谁也没法让你一个星期就跟上节奏。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It's no big deal if you can't figure everything out at once.
sentences.zh: 一下子弄不明白所有事，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Just learn at your own pace.
sentences.zh: 按自己的节奏慢慢学就行。

sentences.en: I like that.
sentences.zh: 这条我喜欢。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Last week, Rachel told me I was making good progress.
sentences.zh: 上周 Rachel 还跟我说，我进步很大。

sentences.en: You were.
sentences.zh: 确实。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You got that old build working on your own.
sentences.zh: 那个旧版本是你一个人弄好的。

sentences.en: Should we tell him to come over and sit with us on Tuesdays?
sentences.zh: 要不要让他星期二过来跟我们坐一起？
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: People feel at home faster when they're not alone.
sentences.zh: 有人陪着，新人会更快觉得自在。

sentences.en: Good idea.
sentences.zh: 好主意。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: And someone needs to fill him in on the kitchen rules, so he doesn't take anyone's milk.
sentences.zh: 还得有人跟他讲讲茶水间的规矩，免得他拿了别人的牛奶。

sentences.en: OK. "Don't hesitate to ask questions instead of guessing."
sentences.zh: 好。「有问题尽管问，别自己瞎猜。」
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: But maybe not forty-seven on your first day.
sentences.zh: 不过第一天最好别问四十七个。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Ha ha.
sentences.zh: 哈哈。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: Last one: "Arrive on time. Stand-up starts at half past nine."
sentences.zh: 最后一条：「准时到。站会九点半开始。」

sentences.en: Is that everything?
sentences.zh: 这就全了？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Almost.
sentences.zh: 差不多了。
sentences.speaker: Mia

sentences.en: "Q: Who's the man in the photo by the kitchen? A: Nobody knows."
sentences.zh: 「问：茶水间旁边照片上的男人是谁？答：没人知道。」

sentences.en: "Don't bother trying to find out. I spent three weeks trying."
sentences.zh: 「别费劲去查了。我查了三个星期。」

cards.note: 数字 + 名词用连字符做形容词，名词不加 s：a one-page guide、a two-hour meeting。
a guide to sth 关于……的指南；也指导游：a tour guide。

cards.zh: （在新地方、新工作）安顿下来；适应
cards.note: to start to feel happy and relaxed in a new home, job or school
cards.tip: 常用进行时问候新人：Are you settling in OK?；后面可接 at / to：settle in to a new job。
cards.example: How are you settling in at your new school?

cards.note: to look at or check something carefully from beginning to end
cards.tip: 开会、交接时常说 Let's go through …：一项一项过。
cards.example: Let's go through the slides before the client arrives.

cards.note: to remember a fact when you are thinking or making a decision
cards.tip: 后面接 that 从句，或者把东西放中间：keep it in mind。比 remember 多一层「做决定时要考虑到」。
cards.example: Keep in mind that the shop closes early on Sundays.

cards.note: responsible for a person, group or piece of work
book a meeting / a room / a table；美式也常说 schedule a meeting。
to contact someone again, or do more, after something has happened
very early in the morning, before you do anything else

cards.zh: 让某人跟上进度；让某人了解最新情况
cards.note: to give someone all the information they need so they can work like everyone else
cards.tip: 人放在 get 和 up 中间；自己「跟上了」说 be up to speed。
cards.example: I'll spend the first morning getting you up to speed on the project.

cards.note: used to say that something is not important or not a problem
cards.tip: 口语；安慰别人或回应道歉时常用。反过来说 It's a big deal. 是「这可是件大事」。

cards.note: to understand or solve something after thinking about it
at the speed that is right for you, not the speed of other people
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：at his own pace；pace 是「步调、速度」。
cards.example: This online course lets you study at your own pace.

cards.note: to improve, or to move forward towards a goal
cards.tip: progress 不可数，不加 a、不加 s；形容进步大说 make good / great progress。
cards.example: We're making good progress on the new design.

cards.note: 程序员说的 build 是编译打包出来的一个版本；动词 build 是「建造、构建」。
alone, or without help from anyone
to come to the place where someone is, especially their home
to feel comfortable and relaxed in a place

cards.zh: 给某人讲讲情况；补上信息
cards.note: to tell someone the details of something they do not know yet
cards.tip: 讲的内容用 on：fill sb in on sth；第 32 课是小陈给 Mia 讲 App。
cards.example: I missed the meeting — can you fill me in?

cards.note: 办公室的 kitchen 是茶水间；英国办公室常见的规矩：自己的杯子自己洗，别拿别人的牛奶。
used to tell someone they should feel free to do something
cards.tip: 邮件结尾常见：Please don't hesitate to contact me. 后面接 to do；比 feel free to do 正式一点。
cards.example: If you need anything, don't hesitate to call me.

cards.note: at the right time, not late
don't bother doing / to do 都对，意思是「别费那个劲了」。
to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
